title: RAS (Research Affairs Secretary)
summary: Academic placements, CDC-Research, Research Scholars Day, R-Connect, PSC-R for MS/PhD scholars.

posts.md:
The **Research Affairs Secretary (RAS)** is the official representative of all **MS and PhD research scholars** at IIT Madras.

The RAS represents research scholars on matters related to academics, research programmes, student-guide relationships, and scholar welfare. Along with the Academic Affairs Secretary, the RAS also oversees key institute facilities such as the Library, PG Senapathy Computer Centre, and the Placement Office.

This guide provides an overview of the student bodies that function under the Research Affairs Secretary.

## Contents

Career, Internships & Placements

Networking, Research Outreach & Events

Scholar Support & Wellbeing

## Career, Internships & Placements

## Academic Placements

The Academic Placements team helps research scholars explore opportunities beyond conventional industry placements.

### Opportunities

- Faculty positions

- Teaching opportunities

- Postdoctoral Fellowships (PDF)

- Research Associate positions

- Foreign exchange programmes

- Academic career guidance

## Career Development Cell – Research (CDC-R)

CDC-R supports the professional growth of research scholars through workshops, mentoring, and career development activities.

### Focus Areas

### Placement Preparation

- Mock interviews

- Resume and Blue Book preparation

- Alumni interaction sessions

### Events & Workshops

- Academic writing

- LaTeX training

- Data analytics workshops

- Patent awareness

- Joint Degree Program (JDP/JSP) guidance

### Entrepreneurship & Mentoring

- Startup awareness

- Industry mentoring

- Alumni mentoring

- Innovation and entrepreneurship support

## Networking, Research Outreach & Events

## Research Scholars Day (RSD)

Research Scholars Day is IIT Madras' flagship annual event celebrating research and innovation on campus.

### Highlights

- Research presentations

- Distinguished speaker sessions

- Career Fair

- Alumni networking

- Industry interaction

- Cultural events

- Competitions and exhibitions

## Research Connect (R-Connect)

Research Connect strengthens collaborations between IIT Madras researchers, industry, alumni, and international institutions.

### Initiatives

- Alumni Connect

- Industry Connect

- Research Magazine

- Research Exhibitions

- International Collaborations

Its primary objective is to promote collaborative research, sponsored projects, internships, and global research opportunities.

## Scholar Support & Wellbeing

## Problem-Solving Cell – Research (PSC-R)

PSC-R provides confidential support to research scholars facing academic, professional, personal, or residential challenges.

**All student cases are handled with complete anonymity and confidentiality.**

### Support Areas

### Personal Support

- Hostel-related issues

- Personal challenges

- Workplace concerns

- Student welfare

### Professional Support

- Academic issues

- Research funding

- Fellowship delays

- Administrative support

### Wellness

- Mental health support

- Professional counselling

- Collaboration with the Wellness Centre, MiTr, and Saathi

### Wellness Events

- Mental health awareness campaigns

- Community support initiatives

- Helping Hands programmes

## Research Clubs (R-Clubs)

Research Clubs encourage collaboration and knowledge-sharing among research scholars across departments.

### Activities

Skill-sharing workshops

Startup brainstorming sessions

Inter-department collaboration

Research facility awareness

Software and instrumentation guidance

Sharing expertise on campus research infrastructure

**Did you know?**

The Research Affairs Secretary supports **MS and PhD scholars** throughout their academic journey—from career development and research collaborations to scholar welfare, networking opportunities, and professional growth. Whether you're looking for postdoctoral opportunities, industry collaborations, skill development, or confidential support, the RAS teams are here to help.
